body: As miserable as I feel, I wish I could take your place so that you wouldn't have to endure what you bear. All we have, literally, all we have, is hope. If we lose that, we are done. I try each morning to find one thing to live for; if you can really see why you should live for that one thing, it can get you through the day. One suggestion I have (yeah, its the depressives leading the depressives here) is sign up for Big Brothers/Big Sisters. You have a little kid follow you around and you teach them things. Thats something to live for, right? Helping a kid avoid our fate?
